ko.title: 레임덕 회기: 중간선거 이후 의회가 반드시 마무리해야 할 일

segments.src: Every two years, American voters head to the polls for the midterm elections, and the results reshape the balance of power in Washington.
segments.tr: 2년마다 미국 유권자들은 중간선거를 위해 투표소로 향하며, 그 결과는 워싱턴의 권력 균형을 재편합니다.

segments.src: But the new Congress does not take office the morning after Election Day.
segments.tr: 하지만 새로운 의회가 선거일 바로 다음 날 아침에 취임하는 것은 아닙니다.

segments.src: Instead, there is a gap of roughly two months in which the outgoing members remain in charge.
segments.tr: 대신, 임기가 끝나는 의원들이 계속 직무를 수행하는 약 두 달간의 공백기가 존재합니다.

segments.src: This stretch is known as the **lame-duck session**, and it often decides how the next year begins.
segments.tr: 이 시기를 **레임덕 회기(lame-duck session)**라고 부르며, 종종 다음 해가 어떻게 시작될지를 결정합니다.

segments.src: ## What Is a Lame-Duck Session?
segments.tr: ## 레임덕 회기란 무엇인가?

segments.src: A lame-duck session is any meeting of Congress after the November election but before the new term starts on January 3.
segments.tr: 레임덕 회기는 11월 선거 이후이면서 1월 3일 새 임기가 시작되기 전까지 열리는 의회의 모든 회의를 말합니다.

segments.src: The name comes from the idea of a "lame duck," an official whose time in office is ending.
segments.tr: 이 이름은 임기가 끝나가는 공직자를 뜻하는 "레임덕(lame duck)"이라는 개념에서 유래했습니다.

segments.src: Some members in the session have lost their races, some have chosen to retire, and others won re-election and will simply continue.
segments.tr: 이 회기에 참여하는 일부 의원들은 선거에서 낙선했고, 일부는 은퇴를 선택했으며, 또 다른 이들은 재선에 성공해 단순히 직무를 이어갑니다.

segments.src: All of them still hold full legislative power until the old Congress officially ends.
segments.tr: 이들 모두는 이전 의회가 공식적으로 종료될 때까지 완전한 입법권을 계속 행사합니다.

segments.src: Under the 20th Amendment, ratified in 1933, the terms of members of Congress begin on January 3.
segments.tr: 1933년에 비준된 제20조 수정헌법에 따라, 의원들의 임기는 1월 3일에 시작됩니다.

segments.src: Before that change, the old Congress could linger until March, which left a long stretch of time when lawmakers who had been voted out still made decisions.
segments.tr: 그 변경 이전에는 이전 의회가 3월까지 이어질 수 있었으며, 이는 낙선한 의원들이 여전히 결정을 내리는 긴 시간을 남겨두었습니다.

segments.src: Moving the date earlier shortened the lame-duck period, but did not remove it.
segments.tr: 날짜를 앞당긴 것은 레임덕 기간을 단축했지만 완전히 없애지는 못했습니다.

segments.src: ## Why the Calendar Creates Pressure
segments.tr: ## 일정이 압박을 만드는 이유

segments.src: Congress rarely finishes everything before the campaign season.
segments.tr: 의회가 선거 운동 시즌 전에 모든 것을 끝마치는 경우는 드뭅니다.

segments.src: Lawmakers spend much of the autumn at home, talking with voters.
segments.tr: 의원들은 가을의 대부분을 지역구에 머물며 유권자들과 대화하는 데 보냅니다.

segments.src: When they return in November, a long list of unfinished tasks is waiting, and a hard deadline sits at the end of the year.
segments.tr: 11월에 의회로 돌아올 때면 끝내지 못한 일들이 산적해 있고, 연말이라는 촉박한 마감일이 기다리고 있습니다.

segments.src: Several kinds of business tend to pile up.
segments.tr: 여러 종류의 업무가 쌓이는 경향이 있습니다.

segments.src: ### Government Funding
segments.tr: ### 정부 예산안

segments.src: The most common item is funding for federal agencies.
segments.tr: 가장 흔한 안건은 연방 기관 자금 지원입니다.

segments.src: The government's fiscal year starts on October 1, and Congress is supposed to pass spending bills by then.
segments.tr: 정부의 회계연도는 10월 1일에 시작되며, 의회는 그때까지 지출법안을 통과시켜야 합니다.

segments.src: In practice, lawmakers often pass a short-term measure called a **continuing resolution**, which keeps agencies running at current levels for a limited time.
segments.tr: 실제로는 의원들이 **임시 예산안(continuing resolution)**이라고 불리는 단기 조치를 통과시켜 한시적으로 기관들이 현재 수준에서 계속 운영되도록 하는 경우가 많습니다.

segments.src: When that measure expires in the weeks after the election, Congress must act again.
segments.tr: 선거 직후 몇 주 안에 해당 조치가 만료되면 의회는 다시 행동에 나서야 합니다.

segments.src: The options usually include:
segments.tr: 선택지에는 대개 다음이 포함됩니다:

segments.src: - Passing a full-year set of spending bills.
segments.tr: - 1년 치 전체 지출법안 통과.

segments.src: - Combining many bills into one large package, often called an omnibus.
segments.tr: - 많은 법안을 하나의 거대한 패키지로 결합하는 방식, 흔히 옴니버스 법안이라고 부름.

segments.src: - Passing another temporary extension to push the decision into the new year.
segments.tr: - 결정을 새해로 미루기 위해 또 다른 임시 연장안 통과.

segments.src: If none of these succeeds, parts of the government can face a shutdown, which delays services and creates uncertainty for federal workers and contractors.
segments.tr: 이 중 어느 것도 성공하지 못하면 정부의 일부가 셧다운(업무 중단)에 직면할 수 있으며, 이는 서비스 지연을 초래하고 연방 직원과 계약업체들에게 불확실성을 안겨줍니다.

segments.src: ### Expiring Policies
segments.tr: ### 만료되는 정책들

segments.src: Many laws are written with end dates.
segments.tr: 많은 법안은 종료일이 명시되어 작성됩니다.

segments.src: Tax provisions, health programs, and other policies may be set to lapse at the end of a year or a fiscal period.
segments.tr: 세제 조항, 보건 프로그램 및 기타 정책들은 한 해나 회계기간의 말에 효력이 소멸되도록 설정되어 있을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Lawmakers often use the lame-duck session to extend, change, or let them expire.
segments.tr: 의원들은 레임덕 회기를 이용해 이러한 정책들을 연장하거나 변경하거나 만료되도록 내버려 둡니다.

segments.src: Because these deadlines are firm, they can become a reason to move legislation that might otherwise stall.
segments.tr: 이러한 마감일이 확고하기 때문에, 그렇지 않으면 좌초될 수 있는 입법을 추진하는 동기가 될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ### Nominations and Other Business
segments.tr: ### 인사 청문 및 기타 업무

segments.src: The Senate may also spend time confirming judges and executive branch officials before the balance of the chamber changes.
segments.tr: 상원은 의회의 세력 균형이 바뀌기 전에 판사와 행정부 고위 관료들을 인준하는 데 시간을 보낼 수도 있습니다.

segments.src: In addition, Congress sometimes handles annual defense policy legislation, disaster relief, and other must-pass items during this window.
segments.tr: 또한 의회는 이 시기에 연례 국방 정책 입법, 재난 지원 및 반드시 처리해야 할 기타 안건들을 다루기도 합니다.

segments.src: ## How the Election Results Change the Mood
segments.tr: ## 선거 결과가 분위기를 바꾸는 방식

segments.src: The tone of a lame-duck session depends heavily on the election outcome.
segments.tr: 레임덕 회기의 분위기는 선거 결과에 크게 좌우됩니다.

segments.src: If control of one or both chambers is about to change hands, the party that is losing power may try to finish priorities while it still can.
segments.tr: 한쪽 또는 양쪽 원의 통제권이 곧 바뀔 예정이라면, 권력을 잃는 정당은 아직 권한이 있을 때 주요 역점 사업을 마무리하려 할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: The party gaining power may prefer to wait, hoping to write the terms of major bills itself in January.
segments.tr: 권력을 얻게 되는 정당은 1월에 직접 주요 법안의 조건을 작성하기를 바라며 기다리는 것을 선호할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: This often leads to a choice between two paths:
segments.tr: 이는 종종 두 가지 길 중 하나를 선택하는 상황으로 이어집니다:

segments.src: 1. **Finish the work now**, which gives certainty but may reflect the priorities of the outgoing majority.
segments.tr: 1. **지금 일을 마무리하기**, 이는 확실성을 주지만 퇴임하는 다수당의 우선순위를 반영할 수 있음.

segments.src: 2. **Delay until the new Congress**, which lets the incoming majority shape the outcome but risks another funding cliff early in the year.
segments.tr: 2. **새 의회까지 연기하기**, 이는 새로 들어올 다수당이 결과를 형성하도록 허용하지만 연초에 또 다른 예산 절벽의 위험을 감수해야 함.

segments.src: When party control does not change, the session may be calmer, though disagreements over spending levels and policy details can still produce tense negotiations.
segments.tr: 정당 통제권이 바뀌지 않을 때는 회기가 더 차분할 수 있지만, 지출 수준과 정책 세부 사항을 둘러싼 이견으로 인해 여전히 긴장감 넘치는 협상이 벌어질 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Why Critics and Supporters Disagree
segments.tr: ## 비판론자와 지지자들이 의견을 달리하는 이유

segments.src: The lame-duck session draws debate about fairness and accountability.
segments.tr: 레임덕 회기는 공정성과 책임성을 두고 논쟁을 불러일으킵니다.

segments.src: Critics argue that lawmakers who were just rejected by voters should not make major decisions, because they no longer face the same electoral pressure.
segments.tr: 비판론자들은 유권자들에게 심판을 받은 지 얼마 안 된 의원들이 더 이상 유권자의 선거 압박에 직면하지 않기 때문에 주요 결정을 내려서는 안 된다고 주장합니다.

segments.src: Supporters respond that members remain duly elected officials until their terms end, and that deadlines leave Congress with little choice but to act.
segments.tr: 지지자들은 의원들이 임기가 끝날 때까지 정당하게 선출된 공직자로 남으며, 마감일 때문에 의회로서는 행동에 나설 수밖에 없다고 반박합니다.

segments.src: They also note that the lack of immediate election pressure can sometimes make compromise easier.
segments.tr: 또한 즉각적인 선거 압박이 없기 때문에 때로는 타협이 더 쉬워질 수 있다고 지적합니다.

segments.src: ## Why It Matters for the Year Ahead
segments.tr: ## 다가오는 해에 이것이 중요한 이유

segments.src: What happens in these few weeks can set the stage for the coming year.
segments.tr: 이 몇 주 동안 일어나는 일은 다가오는 해의 무대를 설정할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: A completed funding package can give agencies stability and clear the new Congress to focus on other priorities.
segments.tr: 완성된 예산 패키지는 기관들에 안정성을 제공하고 새 의회가 다른 우선순위에 집중할 수 있도록 길을 터줄 수 있습니다.

segments.src: A deal that is pushed forward, on the other hand, can mean that the first months of the new term are spent on the same deadlines the previous Congress could not resolve.
segments.tr: 반면에 처리가 미뤄진 합의안은, 새 임기의 첫 몇 달이 이전 의회가 해결하지 못했던 바로 그 마감일들을 처리하는 데 소비됨을 의미할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Decisions on expiring policies also shape what households, businesses, and state governments can expect.
segments.tr: 만료되는 정책에 대한 결정은 가계, 기업, 주정부가 무엇을 기대할 수 있는지도 형성합니다.

segments.src: ## What to Watch For
segments.tr: ## 주목해야 할 점

segments.src: For readers following the process, a few signals are useful:
segments.tr: 이 과정을 지켜보는 독자들에게는 몇 가지 신호가 유용합니다:

segments.src: - **The funding deadline.** Check when the current short-term measure ends, since that date drives much of the schedule.
segments.tr: - **예산 마감일.** 현재의 단기 조치가 언제 끝나는지 확인할 것. 그 날짜가 일정의 많은 부분을 좌우하기 때문임.

segments.src: - **Package size.** A large combined bill suggests leaders want to clear the table before January.
segments.tr: - **패키지 규모.** 거대한 통합 법안은 지도부가 1월 전에 테이블을 깨끗이 비우고 싶어 함을 시사함.

segments.src: - **Leadership statements.** Comments from congressional leaders often reveal whether they plan to finish business or wait.
segments.tr: - **지도부 성명.** 의회 지도자들의 발언은 업무를 마무리할 계획인지 기다릴 것인지 종종 드러냄.

segments.src: - **The list of expiring provisions.** The number and importance of these items show how much pressure lawmakers face.
segments.tr: - **만료되는 조항 목록.** 이러한 항목들의 수와 중요성은 의원들이 얼마나 큰 압박을 받고 있는지 보여줌.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 핵심 요약

segments.src: The lame-duck session is a short but important stretch of the political calendar.
segments.tr: 레임덕 회기는 정치 일정 중 짧지만 중요한 기간입니다.

segments.src: It connects the voters' verdict in November with the work of a new Congress in January, and it reminds us that governing does not pause after the votes are counted.
segments.tr: 이 회기는 11월 유권자들의 심판을 1월 새 의회의 업무와 연결하며, 투표가 집계된 후에도 통치는 멈추지 않는다는 점을 상기시켜 줍니다.

segments.src: Understanding how it works makes it easier to follow the news, and to see why a few weeks at the end of the year can influence much of what follows.
segments.tr: 이것이 어떻게 작동하는지 이해하면 뉴스를 쉽게 따라갈 수 있으며, 연말의 몇 주가 그 이후의 많은 일에 큰 영향을 미칠 수 있는 이유를 알 수 있습니다.

zh.title: “跛脚鸭”会期：国会在期中选举后必须完成的工作

segments.src: Every two years, American voters head to the polls for the midterm elections, and the results reshape the balance of power in Washington.
segments.tr: 每隔两年，美国选民就会前往投票站参加期中选举，选举结果重塑了华盛顿的力量平衡。

segments.src: But the new Congress does not take office the morning after Election Day.
segments.tr: 但新国并不会在选举日后的早晨就职。

segments.src: Instead, there is a gap of roughly two months in which the outgoing members remain in charge.
segments.tr: 相反，会有大约两个月的空白期，即将离任的议员们继续掌权。

segments.src: This stretch is known as the **lame-duck session**, and it often decides how the next year begins.
segments.tr: 这段时间被称为**“跛脚鸭”会期**，它往往决定了新的一年如何开局。

segments.src: ## What Is a Lame-Duck Session?
segments.tr: ## 什么是“跛脚鸭”会期？

segments.src: A lame-duck session is any meeting of Congress after the November election but before the new term starts on January 3.
segments.tr: “跛脚鸭”会期是指11月选举之后、新任期于1月3日开始之前国会的任何会议。

segments.src: The name comes from the idea of a "lame duck," an official whose time in office is ending.
segments.tr: 这个名称源于“跛脚鸭”的概念，即任期即将结束的官员。

segments.src: Some members in the session have lost their races, some have chosen to retire, and others won re-election and will simply continue.
segments.tr: 会期中的一些议员在竞选失利，一些选择退休，另一些则赢得连任并将继续留任。

segments.src: All of them still hold full legislative power until the old Congress officially ends.
segments.tr: 在旧国会正式结束之前，他们都仍然拥有完整的立法权力。

segments.src: Under the 20th Amendment, ratified in 1933, the terms of members of Congress begin on January 3.
segments.tr: 根据1933年批准的《宪法第二十修正案》，国会议员的任期于1月3日开始。

segments.src: Before that change, the old Congress could linger until March, which left a long stretch of time when lawmakers who had been voted out still made decisions.
segments.tr: 在该修正案通过之前，旧国会可能会拖延到3月，这留下了一段很长的时间，在此期间被选下台的议员仍在做出决策。

segments.src: Moving the date earlier shortened the lame-duck period, but did not remove it.
segments.tr: 将日期提前缩短了“跛脚鸭”时期，但并未消除它。

segments.src: ## Why the Calendar Creates Pressure
segments.tr: ## 为什么日程表会带来压力

segments.src: Congress rarely finishes everything before the campaign season.
segments.tr: 国会很少在竞选季之前完成所有事情。

segments.src: Lawmakers spend much of the autumn at home, talking with voters.
segments.tr: 议员们大部分秋天都在家乡与选民交谈。

segments.src: When they return in November, a long list of unfinished tasks is waiting, and a hard deadline sits at the end of the year.
segments.tr: 当他们在11月返回时，一长串未完成的任务正在等待着他们，而年底则有一个严厉的截止日期。

segments.src: Several kinds of business tend to pile up.
segments.tr: 几种类型的工作往往会堆积起来。

segments.src: ### Government Funding
segments.tr: ### 政府资金

segments.src: The most common item is funding for federal agencies.
segments.tr: 最常见的事项是联邦机构的资金。

segments.src: The government's fiscal year starts on October 1, and Congress is supposed to pass spending bills by then.
segments.tr: 政府的财政年度始于10月1日，国会本应在那之前通过支出法案。

segments.src: In practice, lawmakers often pass a short-term measure called a **continuing resolution**, which keeps agencies running at current levels for a limited time.
segments.tr: 在实践中，议员们经常通过一项名为**持续决议**的短期措施，在有限的时间内维持机构按当前水平运转。

segments.src: When that measure expires in the weeks after the election, Congress must act again.
segments.tr: 当该措施在选举后的几周内到期时，国会必须再次采取行动。

segments.src: The options usually include:
segments.tr: 选项通常包括：

segments.src: - Passing a full-year set of spending bills.
segments.tr: - 通过全年的一系列支出法案。

segments.src: - Combining many bills into one large package, often called an omnibus.
segments.tr: - 将许多法案合并成一个大包裹，通常被称为综合法案。

segments.src: - Passing another temporary extension to push the decision into the new year.
segments.tr: - 通过另一次临时延期，将决定推迟到新的一年。

segments.src: If none of these succeeds, parts of the government can face a shutdown, which delays services and creates uncertainty for federal workers and contractors.
segments.tr: 如果这些都没有成功，政府的部分地区可能会面临关门，这会延迟服务并给联邦员工和承包商带来不确定性。

segments.src: ### Expiring Policies
segments.tr: ### 到期的政策

segments.src: Many laws are written with end dates.
segments.tr: 许多法律都规定了终止日期。

segments.src: Tax provisions, health programs, and other policies may be set to lapse at the end of a year or a fiscal period.
segments.tr: 税收条款、健康计划和其他政策可能会在一年或财政周期结束时失效。

segments.src: Lawmakers often use the lame-duck session to extend, change, or let them expire.
segments.tr: 议员们经常利用“跛脚鸭”会期来延长、更改或任由它们过期。

segments.src: Because these deadlines are firm, they can become a reason to move legislation that might otherwise stall.
segments.tr: 由于这些截止日期是死期，它们可以成为推动原本可能停滞的立法的理由。

segments.src: ### Nominations and Other Business
segments.tr: ### 提名和其他事务

segments.src: The Senate may also spend time confirming judges and executive branch officials before the balance of the chamber changes.
segments.tr: 在参议院权力平衡改变之前，参议院也可能会花时间确认法官和行政部门官员的任命。

segments.src: In addition, Congress sometimes handles annual defense policy legislation, disaster relief, and other must-pass items during this window.
segments.tr: 此外，国会有时会在这个窗口期内处理年度国防政策立法、救灾和其他必须通过的事项。

segments.src: ## How the Election Results Change the Mood
segments.tr: ## 选举结果如何改变情绪

segments.src: The tone of a lame-duck session depends heavily on the election outcome.
segments.tr: “跛脚鸭”会期的基调很大程度上取决于选举结果。

segments.src: If control of one or both chambers is about to change hands, the party that is losing power may try to finish priorities while it still can.
segments.tr: 如果一个或两个议院的控制权即将易手，失势的政党可能会试图在还能做到的时候完成优先事项。

segments.src: The party gaining power may prefer to wait, hoping to write the terms of major bills itself in January.
segments.tr: 获得权力的政党可能更愿意等待，希望在1月亲自撰写主要法案的条款。

segments.src: This often leads to a choice between two paths:
segments.tr: 这通常会导致在两条道路之间做出选择：

segments.src: 1. **Finish the work now**, which gives certainty but may reflect the priorities of the outgoing majority.
segments.tr: 1. **现在完成工作**，这提供了确定性，但可能反映了即将离任多数派的优先事项。

segments.src: 2. **Delay until the new Congress**, which lets the incoming majority shape the outcome but risks another funding cliff early in the year.
segments.tr: 2. **推迟到新国会**，这让新当选的多数派塑造结果，但也冒着年初再次面临资金悬崖的风险。

segments.src: When party control does not change, the session may be calmer, though disagreements over spending levels and policy details can still produce tense negotiations.
segments.tr: 当政党控制权没有改变时，会期可能会更平静，尽管在支出水平和政策细节上的分歧仍然可能产生紧张的谈判。

segments.src: ## Why Critics and Supporters Disagree
segments.tr: ## 为什么批评者和支持者意见不一

segments.src: The lame-duck session draws debate about fairness and accountability.
segments.tr: “跛脚鸭”会期引发了关于公平性和问责制的辩论。

segments.src: Critics argue that lawmakers who were just rejected by voters should not make major decisions, because they no longer face the same electoral pressure.
segments.tr: 批评者认为，刚刚被选民拒绝的议员不应该做出重大决策，因为他们不再面临相同的选举压力。

segments.src: Supporters respond that members remain duly elected officials until their terms end, and that deadlines leave Congress with little choice but to act.
segments.tr: 支持者回应称，在任期结束前，议员仍然是正式选出的官员，而且截止日期让国会别无选择，只能采取行动。

segments.src: They also note that the lack of immediate election pressure can sometimes make compromise easier.
segments.tr: 他们还指出，缺乏迫在眉睫的选举压力有时可以使妥协变得更容易。

segments.src: ## Why It Matters for the Year Ahead
segments.tr: ## 为什么这对未来一年很重要

segments.src: What happens in these few weeks can set the stage for the coming year.
segments.tr: 这几周发生的事情可以为来年奠定基础。

segments.src: A completed funding package can give agencies stability and clear the new Congress to focus on other priorities.
segments.tr: 一份完成的资金方案可以为机构提供稳定性，并腾出新国会专注于其他优先事项。

segments.src: A deal that is pushed forward, on the other hand, can mean that the first months of the new term are spent on the same deadlines the previous Congress could not resolve.
segments.tr: 另一方面，被推迟的协议可能意味着新任期的前几个月都花在了上一国会未能解决的相同截止日期上。

segments.src: Decisions on expiring policies also shape what households, businesses, and state governments can expect.
segments.tr: 对过期政策的决定也塑造了家庭、企业和州政府的预期。

segments.src: ## What to Watch For
segments.tr: ## 需要关注什么

segments.src: For readers following the process, a few signals are useful:
segments.tr: 对于关注这一过程的读者来说，几个信号很有用：

segments.src: - **The funding deadline.** Check when the current short-term measure ends, since that date drives much of the schedule.
segments.tr: - **资金截止日期。** 检查当前的短期措施何时结束，因为该日期决定了大部分日程表。

segments.src: - **Package size.** A large combined bill suggests leaders want to clear the table before January.
segments.tr: - **包裹规模。** 一个大型的综合法案表明领导层希望在1月之前清理桌面。

segments.src: - **Leadership statements.** Comments from congressional leaders often reveal whether they plan to finish business or wait.
segments.tr: - **领导层声明。** 国会领导人的评论往往揭示他们是计划完成工作还是等待。

segments.src: - **The list of expiring provisions.** The number and importance of these items show how much pressure lawmakers face.
segments.tr: - **过期条款清单。** 这些事项的数量和重要性表明议员们面临多大的压力。

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 底线

segments.src: The lame-duck session is a short but important stretch of the political calendar.
segments.tr: “跛脚鸭”会期是政治日程表中简短但重要的一段。

segments.src: It connects the voters' verdict in November with the work of a new Congress in January, and it reminds us that governing does not pause after the votes are counted.
segments.tr: 它将11月选民的裁决与1月新国会的工作连接起来，它提醒我们治理在投票统计后并未暂停。

segments.src: Understanding how it works makes it easier to follow the news, and to see why a few weeks at the end of the year can influence much of what follows.
segments.tr: 理解它是如何运作的，可以更容易地关注新闻，并看出为什么年底的几周可以影响随后的许多事情。

segments.tr: *本文仅供一般参考之用，并不代表任何政党或候选人的立场。*

hi.title: द लेम-डुक सत्र: मध्यावधि चुनावों के बाद कांग्रेस को क्या पूरा करना होगा

segments.src: Every two years, American voters head to the polls for the midterm elections, and the results reshape the balance of power in Washington.
segments.tr: हर दो साल में, अमेरिकी मतदाता मध्यावधि चुनावों के लिए मतदान करने जाते हैं, और परिणाम वाशिंगटन में शक्ति के संतुलन को नया रूप देते हैं।

segments.src: But the new Congress does not take office the morning after Election Day.
segments.tr: लेकिन नई कांग्रेस चुनाव के दिन के ठीक अगली सुबह पदभार ग्रहण नहीं करती है।

segments.src: Instead, there is a gap of roughly two months in which the outgoing members remain in charge.
segments.tr: इसके बजाय, लगभग दो महीने का अंतराल होता है जिसमें निवर्तमान सदस्य कार्यभार संभालते रहते हैं।

segments.src: This stretch is known as the **lame-duck session**, and it often decides how the next year begins.
segments.tr: इस अवधि को **लेम-डुक सत्र** (lame-duck session) के रूप में जाना जाता है, और यह अक्सर तय करता है कि अगला साल कैसे शुरू होता है।

segments.src: ## What Is a Lame-Duck Session?
segments.tr: ## लेम-डुक सत्र क्या है?

segments.src: A lame-duck session is any meeting of Congress after the November election but before the new term starts on January 3.
segments.tr: लेम-डुक सत्र नवंबर के चुनाव के बाद लेकिन 3 जनवरी को नए कार्यकाल की शुरुआत से पहले कांग्रेस की कोई भी बैठक है।

segments.src: The name comes from the idea of a "lame duck," an official whose time in office is ending.
segments.tr: यह नाम "लेम डुक" (lame duck) के विचार से आया है, जो एक ऐसा अधिकारी होता है जिसका कार्यकाल समाप्त हो रहा है।

segments.src: Some members in the session have lost their races, some have chosen to retire, and others won re-election and will simply continue.
segments.tr: सत्र के कुछ सदस्यों ने अपने चुनाव हार गए हैं, कुछ ने सेवानिवृत्त होना चुना है, और अन्य ने पुनः चुनाव जीत लिया है और बस जारी रहेंगे।

segments.src: All of them still hold full legislative power until the old Congress officially ends.
segments.tr: पुरानी कांग्रेस आधिकारिक रूप से समाप्त होने तक वे सभी अभी भी पूर्ण विधायी शक्ति रखते हैं।

segments.src: Under the 20th Amendment, ratified in 1933, the terms of members of Congress begin on January 3.
segments.tr: 1933 में अनुसमर्थित 20वें संशोधन के तहत, कांग्रेस के सदस्यों का कार्यकाल 3 जनवरी से शुरू होता है।

segments.src: Before that change, the old Congress could linger until March, which left a long stretch of time when lawmakers who had been voted out still made decisions.
segments.tr: उस बदलाव से पहले, पुरानी कांग्रेस मार्च तक बनी रह सकती थी, जिससे लंबे समय तक ऐसे कानून निर्माता निर्णय लेते रहते थे जिन्हें बाहर का रास्ता दिखा दिया गया था।

segments.src: Moving the date earlier shortened the lame-duck period, but did not remove it.
segments.tr: तारीख को पहले करने से लेम-डुक अवधि छोटी हो गई, लेकिन यह समाप्त नहीं हुई।

segments.src: ## Why the Calendar Creates Pressure
segments.tr: ## क्यों कैलेंडर दबाव पैदा करता है

segments.src: Congress rarely finishes everything before the campaign season.
segments.tr: कांग्रेस शायद ही कभी चुनाव प्रचार के मौसम से पहले सब कुछ पूरा करती है।

segments.src: Lawmakers spend much of the autumn at home, talking with voters.
segments.tr: कानून निर्माता अपनी शरद ऋतु का अधिकांश समय घर पर, मतदाताओं से बात करने में बिताते हैं।

segments.src: When they return in November, a long list of unfinished tasks is waiting, and a hard deadline sits at the end of the year.
segments.tr: जब वे नवंबर में लौटते हैं, तो अधूरे कार्यों की एक लंबी सूची इंतजार कर रही होती है, और वर्ष के अंत में एक कड़ी समय सीमा होती है।

segments.src: Several kinds of business tend to pile up.
segments.tr: कई प्रकार के व्यवसाय जमा होने लगते हैं।

segments.src: ### Government Funding
segments.tr: ### सरकारी फंडिंग

segments.src: The most common item is funding for federal agencies.
segments.tr: सबसे आम मद संघीय एजेंसियों के लिए फंडिंग है।

segments.src: The government's fiscal year starts on October 1, and Congress is supposed to pass spending bills by then.
segments.tr: सरकार का वित्तीय वर्ष 1 अक्टूबर को शुरू होता है, और कांग्रेस से उम्मीद की जाती है कि वह तब तक खर्च के बिल पारित कर दे।

segments.src: In practice, lawmakers often pass a short-term measure called a **continuing resolution**, which keeps agencies running at current levels for a limited time.
segments.tr: व्यवहार में, कानून निर्माता अक्सर **निरंतर संकल्प** (continuing resolution) नामक एक अल्पकालिक उपाय पारित करते हैं, जो सीमित समय के लिए एजेंसियों को वर्तमान स्तर पर चालू रखता है।

segments.src: When that measure expires in the weeks after the election, Congress must act again.
segments.tr: जब चुनाव के हफ्तों बाद वह उपाय समाप्त हो जाता है, तो कांग्रेस को फिर से कार्रवाई करनी होगी।

segments.src: The options usually include:
segments.tr: विकल्पों में आमतौर पर शामिल हैं:

segments.src: - Passing a full-year set of spending bills.
segments.tr: - पूरे साल के खर्च के बिलों का एक सेट पारित करना।

segments.src: - Combining many bills into one large package, often called an omnibus.
segments.tr: - कई बिलों को एक बड़े पैकेज में संयोजित करना, जिसे अक्सर ओमनीबस कहा जाता है।

segments.src: - Passing another temporary extension to push the decision into the new year.
segments.tr: - निर्णय को नए साल में धकेलने के लिए एक और अस्थायी विस्तार पारित करना।

segments.src: If none of these succeeds, parts of the government can face a shutdown, which delays services and creates uncertainty for federal workers and contractors.
segments.tr: यदि इनमें से कोई भी सफल नहीं होता है, तो सरकार के कुछ हिस्से शटडाउन का सामना कर सकते हैं, जिससे सेवाएं विलंबित होती हैं और संघीय श्रमिकों और ठेकेदारों के लिए अनिश्चितता पैदा होती है।

segments.src: ### Expiring Policies
segments.tr: ### समाप्त होने वाली नीतियां

segments.src: Many laws are written with end dates.
segments.tr: कई कानून अंत तिथियों के साथ लिखे गए हैं।

segments.src: Tax provisions, health programs, and other policies may be set to lapse at the end of a year or a fiscal period.
segments.tr: कर प्रावधान, स्वास्थ्य कार्यक्रम और अन्य नीतियां एक वर्ष या वित्तीय अवधि के अंत में समाप्त होने के लिए निर्धारित हो सकती हैं।

segments.src: Lawmakers often use the lame-duck session to extend, change, or let them expire.
segments.tr: कानून निर्माता अक्सर उनका विस्तार करने, उन्हें बदलने या उन्हें समाप्त होने देने के लिए लेम-डुक सत्र का उपयोग करते हैं।

segments.src: Because these deadlines are firm, they can become a reason to move legislation that might otherwise stall.
segments.tr: क्योंकि ये समय सीमाएं पक्की हैं, वे ऐसे कानून को आगे बढ़ाने का कारण बन सकती हैं जो अन्यथा रुक सकता था।

segments.src: ### Nominations and Other Business
segments.tr: ### नामांकन और अन्य व्यवसाय

segments.src: The Senate may also spend time confirming judges and executive branch officials before the balance of the chamber changes.
segments.tr: सीनेट चैंबर का संतुलन बदलने से पहले न्यायाधीशों और कार्यपालिका शाखा के अधिकारियों की पुष्टि करने में भी समय बिता सकती है।

segments.src: In addition, Congress sometimes handles annual defense policy legislation, disaster relief, and other must-pass items during this window.
segments.tr: इसके अलावा, कांग्रेस कभी-कभी इस खिड़की के दौरान वार्षिक रक्षा नीति कानून, आपदा राहत और अन्य जरूरी-पारित होने वाली मदों को संभालती है।

segments.src: ## How the Election Results Change the Mood
segments.tr: ## चुनाव परिणाम मूड को कैसे बदलते हैं

segments.src: The tone of a lame-duck session depends heavily on the election outcome.
segments.tr: लेम-डुक सत्र का लहजा चुनाव परिणाम पर बहुत अधिक निर्भर करता है।

segments.src: If control of one or both chambers is about to change hands, the party that is losing power may try to finish priorities while it still can.
segments.tr: यदि एक या दोनों सदनों का नियंत्रण बदलने वाला है, तो सत्ता खोने वाली पार्टी अपनी प्राथमिकताओं को तब तक पूरा करने की कोशिश कर सकती है जब तक वह कर सकती है।

segments.src: The party gaining power may prefer to wait, hoping to write the terms of major bills itself in January.
segments.tr: सत्ता हासिल करने वाली पार्टी इंतजार करना पसंद कर सकती है, जनवरी में खुद प्रमुख बिलों की शर्तें लिखने की उम्मीद करते हुए।

segments.src: This often leads to a choice between two paths:
segments.tr: यह अक्सर दो रास्तों के बीच की पसंद की ओर ले जाता है:

segments.src: 1. **Finish the work now**, which gives certainty but may reflect the priorities of the outgoing majority.
segments.tr: 1. **काम अभी पूरा करें**, जो निश्चितता देता है लेकिन निवर्तमान बहुमत की प्राथमिकताओं को प्रतिबिंबित कर सकता है।

segments.src: 2. **Delay until the new Congress**, which lets the incoming majority shape the outcome but risks another funding cliff early in the year.
segments.tr: 2. **नई कांग्रेस तक देरी करें**, जो आने वाले बहुमत को परिणाम को आकार देने देती है लेकिन साल की शुरुआत में एक और फंडिंग क्लिफ का जोखिम उठाती है।

segments.src: When party control does not change, the session may be calmer, though disagreements over spending levels and policy details can still produce tense negotiations.

es.title: La sesión de pato cojo: lo que el Congreso debe terminar después de las elecciones de mitad de periodo

segments.src: Every two years, American voters head to the polls for the midterm elections, and the results reshape the balance of power in Washington.
segments.tr: Cada dos años, los votantes estadounidenses acuden a las urnas para las elecciones de mitad de periodo, y los resultados remodelan el equilibrio de poder en Washington.

segments.src: But the new Congress does not take office the morning after Election Day.
segments.tr: Pero el nuevo Congreso no asume el cargo la mañana después del día de las elecciones.

segments.src: Instead, there is a gap of roughly two months in which the outgoing members remain in charge.
segments.tr: En su lugar, hay un intervalo de aproximadamente dos meses en el que los miembros salientes siguen al mando.

segments.src: This stretch is known as the **lame-duck session**, and it often decides how the next year begins.
segments.tr: Este periodo se conoce como la **sesión de pato cojo**, y a menudo decide cómo empieza el año siguiente.

segments.src: ## What Is a Lame-Duck Session?
segments.tr: ## ¿Qué es una sesión de pato cojo?

segments.src: A lame-duck session is any meeting of Congress after the November election but before the new term starts on January 3.
segments.tr: Una sesión de pato cojo es cualquier reunión del Congreso posterior a las elecciones de noviembre pero anterior al inicio del nuevo mandato el 3 de enero.

segments.src: The name comes from the idea of a "lame duck," an official whose time in office is ending.
segments.tr: El nombre proviene de la idea de un "pato cojo" ("lame duck"), un funcionario cuyo tiempo en el cargo está terminando.

segments.src: Some members in the session have lost their races, some have chosen to retire, and others won re-election and will simply continue.
segments.tr: Algunos miembros de la sesión han perdido sus contiendas, algunos han decidido retirarse, y otros ganaron la reelección y simplemente continuarán.

segments.src: All of them still hold full legislative power until the old Congress officially ends.
segments.tr: Todos ellos siguen teniendo pleno poder legislativo hasta que el antiguo Congreso termine oficialmente.

segments.src: Under the 20th Amendment, ratified in 1933, the terms of members of Congress begin on January 3.
segments.tr: Bajo la Vigésima Enmienda, ratificada en 1933, los mandatos de los miembros del Congreso comienzan el 3 de enero.

segments.src: Before that change, the old Congress could linger until March, which left a long stretch of time when lawmakers who had been voted out still made decisions.
segments.tr: Antes de ese cambio, el antiguo Congreso podía prolongarse hasta marzo, lo que dejaba un largo periodo de tiempo en el que los legisladores que no habían sido reelegidos aún tomaban decisiones.

segments.src: Moving the date earlier shortened the lame-duck period, but did not remove it.
segments.tr: Adelantar la fecha acortó el periodo de pato cojo, pero no lo eliminó.

segments.src: ## Why the Calendar Creates Pressure
segments.tr: ## Por qué el calendario genera presión

segments.src: Congress rarely finishes everything before the campaign season.
segments.tr: El Congreso rara vez termina todo antes de la temporada de campaña.

segments.src: Lawmakers spend much of the autumn at home, talking with voters.
segments.tr: Los legisladores pasan gran parte del otoño en casa, hablando con los votantes.

segments.src: When they return in November, a long list of unfinished tasks is waiting, and a hard deadline sits at the end of the year.
segments.tr: Cuando regresan en noviembre, les espera una larga lista de tareas pendientes y una fecha límite estricta al final del año.

segments.src: Several kinds of business tend to pile up.
segments.tr: Varios tipos de asuntos tienden a acumularse.

segments.src: ### Government Funding
segments.tr: ### Financiación del gobierno

segments.src: The most common item is funding for federal agencies.
segments.tr: El tema más común es la financiación para las agencias federales.

segments.src: The government's fiscal year starts on October 1, and Congress is supposed to pass spending bills by then.
segments.tr: El año fiscal del gobierno comienza el 1 de octubre, y se supone que el Congreso debe aprobar los proyectos de ley de presupuestos para entonces.

segments.src: In practice, lawmakers often pass a short-term measure called a **continuing resolution**, which keeps agencies running at current levels for a limited time.
segments.tr: En la práctica, los legisladores a menudo aprueban una medida a corto plazo llamada **resolución continua**, que mantiene a las agencias funcionando a los niveles actuales por un tiempo limitado.

segments.src: When that measure expires in the weeks after the election, Congress must act again.
segments.tr: Cuando esa medida expira en las semanas posteriores a las elecciones, el Congreso debe actuar de nuevo.

segments.src: The options usually include:
segments.tr: Las opciones suelen incluir:

segments.src: - Passing a full-year set of spending bills.
segments.tr: - Aprobar un conjunto de proyectos de ley de presupuestos para todo el año.

segments.src: - Combining many bills into one large package, often called an omnibus.
segments.tr: - Combinar muchos proyectos de ley en un paquete grande, a menudo llamado ómnibus.

segments.src: - Passing another temporary extension to push the decision into the new year.
segments.tr: - Aprobar otra prórroga temporal para trasladar la decisión al nuevo año.

segments.src: If none of these succeeds, parts of the government can face a shutdown, which delays services and creates uncertainty for federal workers and contractors.
segments.tr: Si nada de esto tiene éxito, partes del gobierno pueden enfrentarse a un cierre, lo que retrasa los servicios y crea incertidumbre para los trabajadores federales y contratistas.

segments.src: ### Expiring Policies
segments.tr: ### Políticas que expiran

segments.src: Many laws are written with end dates.
segments.tr: Muchas leyes están escritas con fechas de finalización.

segments.src: Tax provisions, health programs, and other policies may be set to lapse at the end of a year or a fiscal period.
segments.tr: Las disposiciones fiscales, los programas de salud y otras políticas pueden estar programados para caducar al final de un año o un periodo fiscal.

segments.src: Lawmakers often use the lame-duck session to extend, change, or let them expire.
segments.tr: Los legisladores suelen utilizar la sesión de pato cojo para prorrogarlas, cambiarlas o dejar que expiren.

segments.src: Because these deadlines are firm, they can become a reason to move legislation that might otherwise stall.
segments.tr: Debido a que estas fechas límite son firmes, pueden convertirse en un motivo para impulsar legislación que de otro modo se estancaría.

segments.src: ### Nominations and Other Business
segments.tr: ### Nombramientos y otros asuntos

segments.src: The Senate may also spend time confirming judges and executive branch officials before the balance of the chamber changes.
segments.tr: El Senado también puede dedicar tiempo a confirmar jueces y funcionarios de la rama ejecutiva antes de que cambie el equilibrio de la cámara.

segments.src: In addition, Congress sometimes handles annual defense policy legislation, disaster relief, and other must-pass items during this window.
segments.tr: Además, el Congreso a veces maneja legislación anual sobre política de defensa, ayuda en casos de desastre y otros temas de aprobación obligatoria durante esta ventana.

segments.src: ## How the Election Results Change the Mood
segments.tr: ## Cómo cambian el ambiente los resultados electorales

segments.src: The tone of a lame-duck session depends heavily on the election outcome.
segments.tr: El tono de una sesión de pato cojo depende en gran medida del resultado electoral.

segments.src: If control of one or both chambers is about to change hands, the party that is losing power may try to finish priorities while it still can.
segments.tr: Si el control de una o ambas cámaras está a punto de cambiar de manos, el partido que pierde el poder puede intentar terminar prioridades mientras aún puede hacerlo.

segments.src: The party gaining power may prefer to wait, hoping to write the terms of major bills itself in January.
segments.tr: El partido que gana poder puede preferir esperar, con la esperanza de redactar los términos de los proyectos de ley principales por sí mismo en enero.

segments.src: This often leads to a choice between two paths:
segments.tr: Esto suele llevar a una elección entre dos caminos:

segments.src: 1. **Finish the work now**, which gives certainty but may reflect the priorities of the outgoing majority.
segments.tr: 1. **Terminar el trabajo ahora**, lo que da certidumbre pero puede reflejar las prioridades de la mayoría saliente.

segments.src: 2. **Delay until the new Congress**, which lets the incoming majority shape the outcome but risks another funding cliff early in the year.
segments.tr: 2. **Demorar hasta el nuevo Congreso**, lo que permite a la mayoría entrante dar forma al resultado pero arriesga otro abismo financiero a principios de año.

segments.src: When party control does not change, the session may be calmer, though disagreements over spending levels and policy details can still produce tense negotiations.
segments.tr: Cuando el control partidario no cambia, la sesión puede ser más tranquila, aunque los desacuerdos sobre los niveles de gasto y los detalles de las políticas aún pueden producir negociaciones tensas.

segments.src: ## Why Critics and Supporters Disagree
segments.tr: ## Por qué los críticos y los partidarios no están de acuerdo

segments.src: The lame-duck session draws debate about fairness and accountability.
segments.tr: La sesión de pato cojo genera debates sobre la equidad y la rendición de cuentas.

segments.src: Critics argue that lawmakers who were just rejected by voters should not make major decisions, because they no longer face the same electoral pressure.
segments.tr: Los críticos argumentan que los legisladores que acaban de ser rechazados por los votantes no deberían tomar decisiones importantes, porque ya no enfrentan la misma presión electoral.

segments.src: Supporters respond that members remain duly elected officials until their terms end, and that deadlines leave Congress with little choice but to act.
segments.tr: Los partidarios responden que los miembros siguen siendo funcionarios debidamente elegidos hasta que terminan sus mandatos, y que los plazos dejan al Congreso con pocas opciones más que actuar.

segments.src: They also note that the lack of immediate election pressure can sometimes make compromise easier.
segments.tr: También señalan que la falta de presión electoral inmediata a veces puede facilitar el compromiso.

segments.src: ## Why It Matters for the Year Ahead
segments.tr: ## Por qué importa para el año que viene

segments.src: What happens in these few weeks can set the stage for the coming year.
segments.tr: Lo que sucede en estas pocas semanas puede sentar las bases para el próximo año.

segments.src: A completed funding package can give agencies stability and clear the new Congress to focus on other priorities.
segments.tr: Un paquete de financiación completado puede dar estabilidad a las agencias y permitir que el nuevo Congreso se centre en otras prioridades.

segments.src: A deal that is pushed forward, on the other hand, can mean that the first months of the new term are spent on the same deadlines the previous Congress could not resolve.
segments.tr: Un acuerdo que se posterga, por otro lado, puede significar que los primeros meses del nuevo mandato se gasten en las mismas fechas límite que el Congreso anterior no pudo resolver.

segments.src: Decisions on expiring policies also shape what households, businesses, and state governments can expect.
segments.tr: Las decisiones sobre las políticas que expiran también moldean lo que los hogares, las empresas y los gobiernos estatales pueden esperar.

segments.src: ## What to Watch For
segments.tr: ## Qué tener en cuenta

segments.src: For readers following the process, a few signals are useful:
segments.tr: Para los lectores que siguen el proceso, algunas señales son útiles:

segments.src: - **The funding deadline.** Check when the current short-term measure ends, since that date drives much of the schedule.
segments.tr: - **El plazo de financiación.** Compruebe cuándo termina la medida a corto plazo actual, ya que esa fecha impulsa gran parte del calendario.

segments.src: - **Package size.** A large combined bill suggests leaders want to clear the table before January.
segments.tr: - **El tamaño del paquete.** Un proyecto de ley grande y combinado sugiere que los líderes quieren limpiar la mesa antes de enero.

segments.src: - **Leadership statements.** Comments from congressional leaders often reveal whether they plan to finish business or wait.
segments.tr: - **Declaraciones de los líderes.** Los comentarios de los líderes del Congreso a menudo revelan si planean terminar el trabajo o esperar.

segments.src: - **The list of expiring provisions.** The number and importance of these items show how much pressure lawmakers face.
segments.tr: - **La lista de disposiciones que expiran.** El número y la importancia de estos elementos muestran cuánta presión enfrentan los legisladores.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## En resumen

segments.src: The lame-duck session is a short but important stretch of the political calendar.
segments.tr: La sesión de pato cojo es un tramo corto pero importante del calendario político.

segments.src: It connects the voters' verdict in November with the work of a new Congress in January, and it reminds us that governing does not pause after the votes are counted.
segments.tr: Conecta el veredicto de los votantes en noviembre con el trabajo de un nuevo Congreso en enero, y nos recuerda que gobernar no se detiene después de que se cuentan los votos.

segments.src: All of them still hold full legislative power until the old Congress officially ends.
segments.tr: ويحتفظ جميعهم بكامل سلطتهم التشريعية حتى ينتهي الكونغرس القديم رسمياً.

segments.src: Under the 20th Amendment, ratified in 1933, the terms of members of Congress begin on January 3.
segments.tr: بموجب التعديل العشرين، الذي تم إقراره في عام 1933، تبدأ فترات ولاية أعضاء الكونغرس في 3 يناير.

segments.src: Before that change, the old Congress could linger until March, which left a long stretch of time when lawmakers who had been voted out still made decisions.
segments.tr: قبل هذا التغيير، كان بإمكان الكونغرس القديم الاستمرار حتى شهر مارس، مما ترك فترة طويلة اتخذ خلالها المشرعون الذين سقطوا في الانتخابات قرارات مستمرة.

segments.src: Moving the date earlier shortened the lame-duck period, but did not remove it.
segments.tr: أدى تقديم الموعد إلى تقصير فترة البطة العرجاء، لكنه لم يلغها.

segments.src: ## Why the Calendar Creates Pressure
segments.tr: ## لماذا يخلق التقويم ضغطاً

segments.src: Congress rarely finishes everything before the campaign season.
segments.tr: نادراً ما ينهي الكونغرس كل شيء قبل موسم الحملات الانتخابية.

segments.src: Lawmakers spend much of the autumn at home, talking with voters.
segments.tr: يقضي المشرعون جزءاً كبيراً من فصل الخريف في منازلهم متحدثين مع الناخبين.

segments.src: When they return in November, a long list of unfinished tasks is waiting, and a hard deadline sits at the end of the year.
segments.tr: وعندما يعودون في نوفمبر، تكون هناك قائمة طويلة من المهام غير المنجزة في انتظارهم، ويقف الموعد النهائي الصارم في نهاية العام.

segments.src: Several kinds of business tend to pile up.
segments.tr: تميل عدة أنواع من الأعمال إلى التراكم.

segments.src: ### Government Funding
segments.tr: ### تمويل الحكومة

segments.src: The most common item is funding for federal agencies.
segments.tr: البند الأكثر شيوعاً هو تمويل الوكالات الفيدرالية.

segments.src: The government's fiscal year starts on October 1, and Congress is supposed to pass spending bills by then.
segments.tr: تبدأ السنة المالية للحكومة في 1 أكتوبر، ومن المفترض أن يمرر الكونغرس فواتير الإنفاق بحلول ذلك الوقت.

segments.src: In practice, lawmakers often pass a short-term measure called a **continuing resolution**, which keeps agencies running at current levels for a limited time.
segments.tr: في الممارسة العملية، غالباً ما يمرر المشرعون إجراءً قصير الأجل يسمى **قراراً مستمراً**، والذي يحافظ على عمل الوكالات بالمستويات الحالية لفترة محدودة.

segments.src: When that measure expires in the weeks after the election, Congress must act again.
segments.tr: وعندما ينتهي هذا الإجراء في الأسابيع التي تلي الانتخابات، يجب على الكونغرس التحرك مرة أخرى.

segments.src: The options usually include:
segments.tr: عادة ما تشمل الخيارات ما يلي:

segments.src: - Passing a full-year set of spending bills.
segments.tr: - إقرار مجموعة من فواتير الإنفاق لمدة عام كامل.

segments.src: - Combining many bills into one large package, often called an omnibus.
segments.tr: - دمج العديد من الفواتير في حزمة واحدة كبيرة، غالباً ما تُسمى حزمة شاملة.

segments.src: - Passing another temporary extension to push the decision into the new year.
segments.tr: - إقرار تمديد مؤقت آخر لدفع القرار إلى العام الجديد.

segments.src: If none of these succeeds, parts of the government can face a shutdown, which delays services and creates uncertainty for federal workers and contractors.
segments.tr: إذا لم ينجح أي من هذه الأمور، فقد تواجه أجزاء من الحكومة إغلاقاً، مما يؤخر الخدمات ويخلق حالة من عدم اليقين للعمال والمقاولين الفيدراليين.

segments.src: ### Expiring Policies
segments.tr: ### السياسات منتهية الصلاحية

segments.src: Many laws are written with end dates.
segments.tr: العديد من القوانين مكتوبة بتواريخ انتهاء.

segments.src: Tax provisions, health programs, and other policies may be set to lapse at the end of a year or a fiscal period.
segments.tr: قد تكون الأحكام الضريبية والبرامج الصحية والسياسات الأخرى معينة لتنتهي في نهاية العام أو فترة مالية.

segments.src: Lawmakers often use the lame-duck session to extend, change, or let them expire.
segments.tr: غالباً ما يستخدم المشرعون جلسة البطة العرجاء لتمديدها أو تغييرها أو السماح بانقضائها.

segments.src: Because these deadlines are firm, they can become a reason to move legislation that might otherwise stall.
segments.tr: ونظراً لأن هذه المواعيد النهائية صارمة، فيمكن أن تصبح سبباً لتحريك التشريعات التي قد تتعطل لولا ذلك.

segments.src: ### Nominations and Other Business
segments.tr: ### التعيينات والأعمال الأخرى

segments.src: The Senate may also spend time confirming judges and executive branch officials before the balance of the chamber changes.
segments.tr: قد يقضي مجلس الشيوخ وقتاً في تأكيد القضاة ومسؤولي الفرع التنفيذي قبل أن يتغير توازن المجلس.

segments.src: In addition, Congress sometimes handles annual defense policy legislation, disaster relief, and other must-pass items during this window.
segments.tr: بالإضافة إلى ذلك، يتعامل الكونغرس أحياناً مع تشريعات سياسة الدفاع السنوية وإغاثة الكوارث وغيرها من العناصر الضرورية لإقرارها خلال هذه النافذة.

segments.src: ## How the Election Results Change the Mood
segments.tr: ## كيف تغير نتائج الانتخابات المزاج العام

segments.src: The tone of a lame-duck session depends heavily on the election outcome.
segments.tr: تعتمد نبرة جلسة البطة العرجاء بشكل كبير على نتيجة الانتخابات.

segments.src: If control of one or both chambers is about to change hands, the party that is losing power may try to finish priorities while it still can.
segments.tr: إذا كان السيطرة على أحد المجلسين أو كلاهما على وشك الانتقال، فقد يحاول الحزب الذي يفقد السلطة إنهاء أولوياته بينما لا يزال قادراً على ذلك.

segments.src: The party gaining power may prefer to wait, hoping to write the terms of major bills itself in January.
segments.tr: قد يفضل الحزب الذي يكتسب السلطة الانتظار، على أمل صياغة شروط الفواتير الرئيسية بنفسه في يناير.

segments.src: This often leads to a choice between two paths:
segments.tr: غالبًا ما يؤدي هذا إلى الاختيار بين مسارين:

segments.src: 1. **Finish the work now**, which gives certainty but may reflect the priorities of the outgoing majority.
segments.tr: 1. **إنهاء العمل الآن**، مما يمنح اليقين ولكنه قد يعكس أولويات الأغلبية المغادرة.

segments.src: 2. **Delay until the new Congress**, which lets the incoming majority shape the outcome but risks another funding cliff early in the year.
segments.tr: 2. **التأجيل حتى الكونغرس الجديد**، مما يتيح للأغلبية القادمة تشكيل النتيجة ولكنه يخاطر بوقوع أزمة تمويل أخرى في وقت مبكر من العام.

segments.src: When party control does not change, the session may be calmer, though disagreements over spending levels and policy details can still produce tense negotiations.
segments.tr: عندما لا تتغير السيطرة الحزبية، قد تكون الجلسة أكثر هدوءاً، على الرغم من أن الخلافات حول مستويات الإنفاق وتفاصيل السياسة لا تزال تولد مفاوضات متوترة.

segments.src: ## Why Critics and Supporters Disagree
segments.tr: ## لماذا يختلف النقاد والمؤيدون

segments.src: The lame-duck session draws debate about fairness and accountability.
segments.tr: تثير جلسة البطة العرجاء نقاشاً حول العدالة والمحاسبة.

segments.src: Critics argue that lawmakers who were just rejected by voters should not make major decisions, because they no longer face the same electoral pressure.
segments.tr: يجادل النقاد بأن المشرعين الذين تم رفضهم للتو من قبل الناخبين يجب ألا يتخذوا قرارات كبرى، لأنهم لم يعودوا يواجهون نفس الضغط الانتخابي.

segments.src: Supporters respond that members remain duly elected officials until their terms end, and that deadlines leave Congress with little choice but to act.
segments.tr: ويرد المؤيدون بأن الأعضاء يظلجون مسؤولين منتخَبين أصولاً حتى تنتهي ولايتهم، وأن المواعيد النهائية لا تترك للكونغرس خياراً سوى التصرف.

segments.src: They also note that the lack of immediate election pressure can sometimes make compromise easier.
segments.tr: ويشيرون أيضاً إلى أن غياب الضغط الانتخابي الفوري يمكن أحياناً أن يجعل التسوية أسهل.

segments.src: ## Why It Matters for the Year Ahead
segments.tr: ## لماذا يهم الأمر للعام القادم

segments.src: What happens in these few weeks can set the stage for the coming year.
segments.tr: ما يحدث في هذه الأسابيع القليلة يمكن أن يمهد الطريق للعام القادم.

segments.src: A completed funding package can give agencies stability and clear the new Congress to focus on other priorities.
segments.tr: حزمة التمويل المكتملة يمكن أن تمنح الوكالات الاستقرار وتفسح المجال للكونغرس الجديد للتركيز على أولويات أخرى.

segments.src: A deal that is pushed forward, on the other hand, can mean that the first months of the new term are spent on the same deadlines the previous Congress could not resolve.
segments.tr: من ناحية أخرى، يمكن أن تعني الصفقة التي تتم دفعها للأمام أن الأشهر الأولى من الولاية الجديدة تُقضى على نفس المواعيد النهائية التي لم يتمكن الكونغرس السابق من حلها.

segments.src: Decisions on expiring policies also shape what households, businesses, and state governments can expect.
segments.tr: القرارات المتعلقة بالسياسات منتهية الصلاحية تشكل أيضاً ما يمكن أن تتوقعه العصور والشركات وحكومات الولايات.

segments.src: ## What to Watch For
segments.tr: ## ما الذي يجب مراقبته

segments.src: For readers following the process, a few signals are useful:
segments.tr: بالنسبة للقراء الذين يتابعون العملية، فإن بعض الإشارات مفيدة:

segments.src: - **The funding deadline.** Check when the current short-term measure ends, since that date drives much of the schedule.
segments.tr: - **الموعد النهائي للتمويل.** تحقق من متى ينتهي الإجراء قصير الأجل الحالي، لأن هذا التاريخ يقود جزءاً كبيرًا من الجدول الزمني.

segments.src: - **Package size.** A large combined bill suggests leaders want to clear the table before January.
segments.tr: - **حجم الحزمة.** يشير مشروع القانون المجمع الكبير إلى أن القادة يريدون تنظيف الطاولة قبل يناير.

segments.src: - **Leadership statements.** Comments from congressional leaders often reveal whether they plan to finish business or wait.
segments.tr: - **تصريحات القيادة.** غالباً ما تكشف التعليقات الصادرة عن قادة الكونغرس ما إذا كانوا يخططون لإنهاء العمل أو الانتظار.

segments.src: - **The list of expiring provisions.** The number and importance of these items show how much pressure lawmakers face.
segments.tr: - **قائمة الأحكام منتهية الصلاحية.** يظهر عدد وأهمية هذه العناصر مقدار الضغط الذي يواجهه المشرعون.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## الخلاصة

segments.src: The lame-duck session is a short but important stretch of the political calendar.
segments.tr: جلسة البطة العرجاء هي امتداد قصير ولكنه مهم للتقويم السياسي.

segments.src: It connects the voters' verdict in November with the work of a new Congress in January, and it reminds us that governing does not pause after the votes are counted.
segments.tr: فهي تربط حكم الناخبين في نوفمبر بعمل الكونغرس الجديد في يناير، وتذكرنا بأن الحكم لا يتوقف بعد فرز الأصوات.

segments.src: Understanding how it works makes it easier to follow the news, and to see why a few weeks at the end of the year can influence much of what follows.
segments.tr: فهم كيف تعمل يجعل من السهل متابعة الأخبار، ورؤية لماذا يمكن لأسابيع قليلة في نهاية العام أن تؤثر على الكثير مما يتبعها.

fr.title: La session des canards boiteux : ce que le Congrès doit achever après les élections de mi-mandat

segments.src: Every two years, American voters head to the polls for the midterm elections, and the results reshape the balance of power in Washington.
segments.tr: Tous les deux ans, les électeurs américains se rendent aux urnes pour les élections de mi-mandat, et les résultats remodèlent l'équilibre des pouvoirs à Washington.

segments.src: But the new Congress does not take office the morning after Election Day.
segments.tr: Mais le nouveau Congrès n'entre pas en fonction le lendemain matin du jour du scrutin.

segments.src: Instead, there is a gap of roughly two months in which the outgoing members remain in charge.
segments.tr: Au lieu de cela, il y a un écart d'environ deux mois pendant lequel les membres sortants restent aux commandes.

segments.src: This stretch is known as the **lame-duck session**, and it often decides how the next year begins.
segments.tr: Cette période est connue sous le nom de **session des canards boiteux**, et elle décide souvent de la manière dont commence l'année suivante.

segments.src: ## What Is a Lame-Duck Session?
segments.tr: ## Qu'est-ce qu'une session des canards boiteux ?

segments.src: A lame-duck session is any meeting of Congress after the November election but before the new term starts on January 3.
segments.tr: Une session de canard boiteux est toute réunion du Congrès après l'élection de novembre mais avant le début du nouveau mandat le 3 janvier.

segments.src: The name comes from the idea of a "lame duck," an official whose time in office is ending.
segments.tr: Le nom vient de l'idée d'un "canard boiteux", un responsable dont le mandat touche à sa fin.

segments.src: Some members in the session have lost their races, some have chosen to retire, and others won re-election and will simply continue.
segments.tr: Certains membres de la session ont perdu leurs courses, d'autres ont choisi de prendre leur retraite, et d'autres encore ont gagné leur réélection et continueront tout simplement.

segments.src: All of them still hold full legislative power until the old Congress officially ends.
segments.tr: Tous détiennent encore l'plein pouvoir législatif jusqu'à ce que l'ancien Congrès se termine officiellement.

segments.src: Under the 20th Amendment, ratified in 1933, the terms of members of Congress begin on January 3.
segments.tr: En vertu du 20e amendement, ratifié en 1933, les mandats des membres du Congrès commencent le 3 janvier.

segments.src: Before that change, the old Congress could linger until March, which left a long stretch of time when lawmakers who had been voted out still made decisions.
segments.tr: Avant ce changement, l'ancien Congrès pouvait s'attarder jusqu'en mars, ce qui laissait une longue période de temps où les législateurs qui avaient été battus prenaient encore des décisions.

segments.src: Moving the date earlier shortened the lame-duck period, but did not remove it.
segments.tr: Avancer la date a raccourci la période du canard boiteux, mais ne l'a pas supprimée.

segments.src: ## Why the Calendar Creates Pressure
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi le calendrier crée la pression

segments.src: Congress rarely finishes everything before the campaign season.
segments.tr: Le Congrès termine rarement tout avant la saison de campagne.

segments.src: Lawmakers spend much of the autumn at home, talking with voters.
segments.tr: Les législateurs passent une grande partie de l'automne chez eux, à parler avec les électeurs.

segments.src: When they return in November, a long list of unfinished tasks is waiting, and a hard deadline sits at the end of the year.
segments.tr: Quand ils reviennent en novembre, une longue liste de tâches inachevées les attend, et une date limite stricte se trouve à la fin de l'année.

segments.src: Several kinds of business tend to pile up.
segments.tr: Plusieurs types d'affaires ont tendance à s'accumuler.

segments.src: ### Government Funding
segments.tr: ### Financement du gouvernement

segments.src: The most common item is funding for federal agencies.
segments.tr: L'élément le plus courant est le financement des agences fédérales.

segments.src: The government's fiscal year starts on October 1, and Congress is supposed to pass spending bills by then.
segments.tr: L'exercice budgétaire du gouvernement commence le 1er octobre, et le Congrès est censé voter les lois de finances d'ici là.

segments.src: In practice, lawmakers often pass a short-term measure called a **continuing resolution**, which keeps agencies running at current levels for a limited time.
segments.tr: En pratique, les législateurs adoptent souvent une mesure à court terme appelée **résolution continue**, qui maintient les agences en activité aux niveaux actuels pour une durée limitée.

segments.src: When that measure expires in the weeks after the election, Congress must act again.
segments.tr: Lorsque cette mesure expire dans les semaines suivant l'élection, le Congrès doit agir à nouveau.

segments.src: The options usually include:
segments.tr: Les options incluent généralement :

segments.src: - Passing a full-year set of spending bills.
segments.tr: - L'adoption d'un ensemble complet de projets de loi de dépenses pour toute l'année.

segments.src: - Combining many bills into one large package, often called an omnibus.
segments.tr: - La combinaison de nombreux projets de loi en un seul grand ensemble, souvent appelé omnibus.

segments.src: - Passing another temporary extension to push the decision into the new year.
segments.tr: - L'adoption d'une autre prolongation temporaire pour reporter la décision à la nouvelle année.

segments.src: If none of these succeeds, parts of the government can face a shutdown, which delays services and creates uncertainty for federal workers and contractors.
segments.tr: Si rien de tout cela ne réussit, certaines parties du gouvernement peuvent faire face à une fermeture, ce qui retarde les services et crée de l'incertitude pour les travailleurs fédéraux et les sous-traitants.

segments.src: ### Expiring Policies
segments.tr: ### Politiques expirant

segments.src: Many laws are written with end dates.
segments.tr: De nombreuses lois sont rédigées avec des dates de fin.

segments.src: Tax provisions, health programs, and other policies may be set to lapse at the end of a year or a fiscal period.
segments.tr: Les dispositions fiscales, les programmes de santé et d'autres politiques peuvent être programmés pour expirer à la fin d'une année ou d'une période budgétaire.

segments.src: Lawmakers often use the lame-duck session to extend, change, or let them expire.
segments.tr: Les législateurs utilisent souvent la session des canards boiteux pour les prolonger, les modifier ou les laisser expirer.

segments.src: Because these deadlines are firm, they can become a reason to move legislation that might otherwise stall.
segments.tr: Parce que ces délais sont fermes, ils peuvent devenir une raison de faire avancer une législation qui pourrait autrement stagner.

segments.src: ### Nominations and Other Business
segments.tr: ### Nominations et autres affaires

segments.src: The Senate may also spend time confirming judges and executive branch officials before the balance of the chamber changes.
segments.tr: Le Sénat peut également passer du temps à confirmer des juges et des responsables de la branche exécutive avant que l'équilibre de la chambre ne change.

segments.src: In addition, Congress sometimes handles annual defense policy legislation, disaster relief, and other must-pass items during this window.
segments.tr: De plus, le Congrès traite parfois des lois annuelles sur la politique de défense, de l'aide en cas de catastrophe et d'autres éléments incontournables pendant cette fenêtre.

segments.src: ## How the Election Results Change the Mood
segments.tr: ## Comment les résultats des élections changent l'humeur

segments.src: The tone of a lame-duck session depends heavily on the election outcome.
segments.tr: Le ton d'une session de canard boiteux dépend fortement du résultat de l'élection.

segments.src: If control of one or both chambers is about to change hands, the party that is losing power may try to finish priorities while it still can.
segments.tr: Si le contrôle d'une ou des deux chambres est sur le point de changer de mains, le parti qui perd le pouvoir peut essayer de terminer ses priorités pendant qu'il le peut encore.

segments.src: The party gaining power may prefer to wait, hoping to write the terms of major bills itself in January.
segments.tr: Le parti qui gagne le pouvoir peut préférer attendre, espérant rédiger lui-même les termes des grands projets de loi en janvier.

segments.src: This often leads to a choice between two paths:
segments.tr: Cela conduit souvent à un choix entre deux voies :

segments.src: 1. **Finish the work now**, which gives certainty but may reflect the priorities of the outgoing majority.
segments.tr: 1. **Terminer le travail maintenant**, ce qui donne de la certitude mais peut refléter les priorités de la majorité sortante.

segments.src: 2. **Delay until the new Congress**, which lets the incoming majority shape the outcome but risks another funding cliff early in the year.
segments.tr: 2. **Retarder jusqu'au nouveau Congrès**, ce qui permet à la majorité entrante de façonner le résultat mais risque une autre falaise budgétaire au début de l'année.

segments.src: When party control does not change, the session may be calmer, though disagreements over spending levels and policy details can still produce tense negotiations.
segments.tr: Lorsque le contrôle du parti ne change pas, la session peut être plus calme, bien que les désaccords sur les niveaux de dépenses et les détails des politiques puissent encore produire des négociations tendues.

segments.src: ## Why Critics and Supporters Disagree
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi les critiques et les partisans sont en désaccord

segments.src: The lame-duck session draws debate about fairness and accountability.
segments.tr: La session des canards boiteux suscite un débat sur l'équité et la responsabilité.

segments.src: Critics argue that lawmakers who were just rejected by voters should not make major decisions, because they no longer face the same electoral pressure.
segments.tr: Les critiques soutiennent que les législateurs qui viennent d'être rejetés par les électeurs ne devraient pas prendre de décisions majeures, car ils ne font plus face à la même pression électorale.

segments.src: Supporters respond that members remain duly elected officials until their terms end, and that deadlines leave Congress with little choice but to act.
segments.tr: Les partisans répondent que les membres restent des responsables dûment élus jusqu'à la fin de leur mandat, et que les délais laissent au Congrès peu d'autre choix que d'agir.

segments.src: They also note that the lack of immediate election pressure can sometimes make compromise easier.
segments.tr: Ils notent également que l'absence de pression électorale immédiate peut parfois rendre le compromis plus facile.

pt.title: A Sessão Lame-Duck: O que o Congresso Deve Concluir Após as Eleições de Meio de Mandato

segments.src: Every two years, American voters head to the polls for the midterm elections, and the results reshape the balance of power in Washington.
segments.tr: A cada dois anos, os eleitores americanos vão às urnas para as eleições de meio de mandato, e os resultados redefinem o equilíbrio de poder em Washington.

segments.src: But the new Congress does not take office the morning after Election Day.
segments.tr: Mas o novo Congresso não assume o cargo na manhã seguinte ao Dia da Eleição.

segments.src: Instead, there is a gap of roughly two months in which the outgoing members remain in charge.
segments.tr: Em vez disso, há um intervalo de cerca de dois meses durante o qual os membros que estão de saída permanecem no comando.

segments.src: This stretch is known as the **lame-duck session**, and it often decides how the next year begins.
segments.tr: Esse período é conhecido como **sessão lame-duck** (sessão do mandato expirante), e muitas vezes decide como o ano seguinte começará.

segments.src: ## What Is a Lame-Duck Session?
segments.tr: ## O Que É uma Sessão Lame-Duck?

segments.src: A lame-duck session is any meeting of Congress after the November election but before the new term starts on January 3.
segments.tr: Uma sessão lame-duck é qualquer reunião do Congresso após a eleição de novembro, mas antes que o novo mandato comece em 3 de janeiro.

segments.src: The name comes from the idea of a "lame duck," an official whose time in office is ending.
segments.tr: O nome vem da ideia de um "pato manco" (lame duck), um oficial cujo mandato está chegando ao fim.

segments.src: Some members in the session have lost their races, some have chosen to retire, and others won re-election and will simply continue.
segments.tr: Alguns membros na sessão perderam suas disputas, alguns optaram por se aposentar e outros venceram a reeleição e simplesmente continuarão.

segments.src: All of them still hold full legislative power until the old Congress officially ends.
segments.tr: Todos eles ainda detêm pleno poder legislativo até que o antigo Congresso termine oficialmente.

segments.src: Under the 20th Amendment, ratified in 1933, the terms of members of Congress begin on January 3.
segments.tr: Sob a 20ª Emenda, ratificada em 1933, os mandatos dos membros do Congresso começam em 3 de janeiro.

segments.src: Before that change, the old Congress could linger until March, which left a long stretch of time when lawmakers who had been voted out still made decisions.
segments.tr: Antes dessa mudança, o antigo Congresso podia se arrastar até março, o que deixava um longo período de tempo em que parlamentares derrotados nas urnas ainda tomavam decisões.

segments.src: Moving the date earlier shortened the lame-duck period, but did not remove it.
segments.tr: Mudar a data para mais cedo encurtou o período lame-duck, mas não o eliminou.

segments.src: ## Why the Calendar Creates Pressure
segments.tr: ## Por Que o Calendário Cria Pressão

segments.src: Congress rarely finishes everything before the campaign season.
segments.tr: O Congresso raramente termina tudo antes da temporada de campanha.

segments.src: Lawmakers spend much of the autumn at home, talking with voters.
segments.tr: Os parlamentares passam grande parte do outono em seus estados/distritos, conversando com os eleitores.

segments.src: When they return in November, a long list of unfinished tasks is waiting, and a hard deadline sits at the end of the year.
segments.tr: Quando eles retornam em novembro, uma longa lista de tarefas inacabadas está à espera, e um prazo rígido fica no final do ano.

segments.src: Several kinds of business tend to pile up.
segments.tr: Vários tipos de assuntos tendem a se acumular.

segments.src: ### Government Funding
segments.tr: ### Financiamento do Governo

segments.src: The most common item is funding for federal agencies.
segments.tr: O item mais comum é o financiamento para as agências federais.

segments.src: The government's fiscal year starts on October 1, and Congress is supposed to pass spending bills by then.
segments.tr: O ano fiscal do governo começa em 1º de outubro, e o Congresso deve aprovar os projetos de lei de orçamentos até lá.

segments.src: In practice, lawmakers often pass a short-term measure called a **continuing resolution**, which keeps agencies running at current levels for a limited time.
segments.tr: Na prática, os parlamentares costumam aprovar uma medida de curto prazo chamada **resolução contínua**, que mantém as agências funcionando nos níveis atuais por um tempo limitado.

segments.src: When that measure expires in the weeks after the election, Congress must act again.
segments.tr: Quando essa medida expira nas semanas após a eleição, o Congresso precisa agir novamente.

segments.src: The options usually include:
segments.tr: As opções geralmente incluem:

segments.src: - Passing a full-year set of spending bills.
segments.tr: - Aprovar um conjunto de projetos de lei de orçamentos para o ano todo.

segments.src: - Combining many bills into one large package, often called an omnibus.
segments.tr: - Combinar muitos projetos em um único grande pacote, muitas vezes chamado de omnibus.

segments.src: - Passing another temporary extension to push the decision into the new year.
segments.tr: - Aprovar outra extensão temporária para empurrar a decisão para o novo ano.

segments.src: If none of these succeeds, parts of the government can face a shutdown, which delays services and creates uncertainty for federal workers and contractors.
segments.tr: Se nenhuma dessas opções der certo, partes do governo podem enfrentar uma paralisação (shutdown), o que atrasa serviços e gera incerteza para servidores e prestadores de serviços federais.

segments.src: ### Expiring Policies
segments.tr: ### Políticas que Estão Expirando

segments.src: Many laws are written with end dates.
segments.tr: Muitas leis são redigidas com datas de término.

segments.src: Tax provisions, health programs, and other policies may be set to lapse at the end of a year or a fiscal period.
segments.tr: Disposições fiscais, programas de saúde e outras políticas podem estar previstos para expirar no final de um ano ou de um período fiscal.

segments.src: Lawmakers often use the lame-duck session to extend, change, or let them expire.
segments.tr: Os parlamentares costumam usar a sessão lame-duck para prorrogá-las, alterá-las ou deixá-las expirar.

segments.src: Because these deadlines are firm, they can become a reason to move legislation that might otherwise stall.
segments.tr: Como esses prazos são firmes, eles podem se tornar um motivo para fazer avançar legislações que, de outra forma, ficariam estagnadas.

segments.src: ### Nominations and Other Business
segments.tr: ### Nomeações e Outros Assuntos

segments.src: The Senate may also spend time confirming judges and executive branch officials before the balance of the chamber changes.
segments.tr: O Senado também pode dedicar tempo para confirmar juízes e autoridades do Poder Executivo antes que o equilíbrio da câmara mude.

segments.src: In addition, Congress sometimes handles annual defense policy legislation, disaster relief, and other must-pass items during this window.
segments.tr: Além disso, o Congresso às vezes lida com leis anuais de política de defesa, ajuda em desastres e outros itens de aprovação obrigatória durante essa janela.

segments.src: ## How the Election Results Change the Mood
segments.tr: ## Como os Resultados das Eleições Mudam o Clima

segments.src: The tone of a lame-duck session depends heavily on the election outcome.
segments.tr: O tom de uma sessão lame-duck depende fortemente do resultado da eleição.

segments.src: If control of one or both chambers is about to change hands, the party that is losing power may try to finish priorities while it still can.
segments.tr: Se o controle de uma ou de ambas as câmaras estiver prestes a mudar de mãos, o partido que está perdendo o poder pode tentar concluir suas prioridades enquanto ainda pode.

segments.src: The party gaining power may prefer to wait, hoping to write the terms of major bills itself in January.
segments.tr: O partido que está ganhando poder pode preferir esperar, esperando redigir os termos dos principais projetos de lei em janeiro.

segments.src: This often leads to a choice between two paths:
segments.tr: Isso muitas vezes leva a uma escolha entre dois caminhos:

segments.src: 1. **Finish the work now**, which gives certainty but may reflect the priorities of the outgoing majority.
segments.tr: 1. **Concluir o trabalho agora**, o que dá certeza, mas pode refletir as prioridades da maioria de saída.

segments.src: 2. **Delay until the new Congress**, which lets the incoming majority shape the outcome but risks another funding cliff early in the year.
segments.tr: 2. **Adiar até o novo Congresso**, o que permite que a nova maioria molde o resultado, mas corre o risco de outro abismo de financiamento no início do ano.

segments.src: When party control does not change, the session may be calmer, though disagreements over spending levels and policy details can still produce tense negotiations.
segments.tr: Quando o controle partidário não muda, a sessão pode ser mais calma, embora divergências sobre níveis de gastos e detalhes de políticas ainda possam gerar negociações tensas.

segments.src: ## Why Critics and Supporters Disagree
segments.tr: ## Por Que Críticos e Apoiadores Discordam

segments.src: The lame-duck session draws debate about fairness and accountability.
segments.tr: A sessão lame-duck gera debates sobre justiça e prestação de contas.

segments.src: Critics argue that lawmakers who were just rejected by voters should not make major decisions, because they no longer face the same electoral pressure.
segments.tr: Críticos argumentam que parlamentares que acabaram de ser rejeitados pelos eleitores não deveriam tomar grandes decisões, porque não enfrentam mais a mesma pressão eleitoral.

segments.src: Supporters respond that members remain duly elected officials until their terms end, and that deadlines leave Congress with little choice but to act.
segments.tr: Apoiadores respondem que os membros continuam sendo autoridades devidamente eleitas até o término de seus mandatos, e que os prazos deixam o Congresso com pouca escolha a não ser agir.

segments.src: They also note that the lack of immediate election pressure can sometimes make compromise easier.
segments.tr: Eles também observam que a falta de pressão eleitoral imediata às vezes pode facilitar compromissos e acordos.

segments.src: ## Why It Matters for the Year Ahead
segments.tr: ## Por Que Isso Importa para o Ano Seguint

segments.src: What happens in these few weeks can set the stage for the coming year.
segments.tr: O que acontece nessas poucas semanas pode definir o cenário para o ano seguinte.

segments.src: A completed funding package can give agencies stability and clear the new Congress to focus on other priorities.
segments.tr: Um pacote de financiamento concluído pode dar estabilidade às agências e liberar o novo Congresso para se concentrar em outras prioridades.

segments.src: A deal that is pushed forward, on the other hand, can mean that the first months of the new term are spent on the same deadlines the previous Congress could not resolve.
segments.tr: Um acordo adiantado, por outro lado, pode significar que os primeiros meses do novo mandato sejam gastos nos mesmos prazos que o Congresso anterior não conseguiu resolver.

segments.src: Decisions on expiring policies also shape what households, businesses, and state governments can expect.
segments.tr: Decisões sobre políticas que estão expirando também moldam o que famílias, empresas e governos estaduais podem esperar.

segments.src: ## What to Watch For
segments.tr: ## O Que Observar

segments.src: For readers following the process, a few signals are useful:
segments.tr: Para os leitores que acompanham o processo, alguns sinais são úteis:

segments.src: - **The funding deadline.** Check when the current short-term measure ends, since that date drives much of the schedule.
segments.tr: - **O prazo de financiamento.** Verifique quando a medida atual de curto prazo termina, pois essa data impulsiona grande parte do cronograma.

segments.src: - **Package size.** A large combined bill suggests leaders want to clear the table before January.
segments.tr: - **Tamanho do pacote.** Um grande projeto de lei combinado sugere que os líderes querem limpar a pauta antes de janeiro.

segments.src: - **Leadership statements.** Comments from congressional leaders often reveal whether they plan to finish business or wait.
segments.tr: - **Declarações das lideranças.** Comentários dos líderes congressuais frequentemente revelam se eles planejam concluir os trabalhos ou esperar.

segments.src: - **The list of expiring provisions.** The number and importance of these items show how much pressure lawmakers face.
segments.tr: - **A lista de disposições que estão expirando.** A quantidade e a importância desses itens mostram quanta pressão os parlamentares enfrentam.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Conclusão

segments.src: The lame-duck session is a short but important stretch of the political calendar.
segments.tr: A sessão lame-duck é um período curto, mas importante, do calendário político.

segments.src: It connects the voters' verdict in November with the work of a new Congress in January, and it reminds us that governing does not pause after the votes are counted.
segments.tr: Ela conecta o veredito dos eleitores em novembro com o trabalho de um novo Congresso em janeiro, e nos lembra que governar não para depois que os votos são contados.

segments.src: Understanding how it works makes it easier to follow the news, and to see why a few weeks at the end of the year can influence much of what follows.
segments.tr: Entender como ela funciona torna mais fácil acompanhar as notícias e ver por que algumas semanas no final do ano podem influenciar muito do que vem a seguir.

segments.src: ## Why Critics and Supporters Disagree

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
